summary: Frontend-only regression pass for iteration 13. Verified all 3 refactor items on the deployed preview URL (mobile 390x844 viewport): (1) Shared iOS-style Toggle component correctly used in AppSettingsModal (settings-toggle-hydration/streaks/weekly-digest) AND RemindersCard (reminder-toggle-*), all render role='switch' with aria-checked and h-6 w-11 pill track + white knob; toggle state changes on click. (2) Dashboard Water metric card now opens NEW Log Water modal (data-testid=log-water-modal) instead of navigating to /nutrition - verified current value displays (750 ml -> 1000 ml after +250ml quick add), progress bar shows percent, toast '+250ml logged!' appeared, URL stayed on /dashboard. Calories card still routes to /nutrition (regression OK). (3) Activity Tracker header shows back chevron (data-testid=activity-back-button) that navigates to /dashboard. (4) Quick Actions -> Add Drink navigates to /dashboard and opens Log Water modal (no silent 250ml log). (5) Notifications n2 (Hydration Alert) opens Log Water modal directly on /dashboard. (6) Reminder toggle persistence verified via page reload (PUT succeeded, state preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: LogWaterModal / BottomSheet: no Escape-key handler observed to dismiss the bottom sheet (had to click overlay). Minor UX nit, not blocking.
AppSettingsModal notification toggles persist only to localStorage (no backend PUT). This is by design per spec, but worth noting so users know these don't sync across devices.
